name: Jamg He
summary: Chinese materials and hardware producer with over two decades in UV-curing and 3D printing, selling FDM filaments, SLA/LCD/DLP resins, LCD printers, UV ink, curing boxes and dryers. It is the manufacturer behind the AceAddity retail filament label.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). Neither company's own site acknowledges the arrangement, so it is recorded as owner-verified ground truth without external corroboration; AceAddity has no independent catalog presence and gets no separate entry.

product_lines.name: Matt PLA / Ultra-Matte PLA
product_lines.notes: Matte-additive PLA; two separate SKUs on the site.

product_lines.name: PETG / High-Speed PETG
product_lines.notes: Standard and high-flow PETG; no high-flow PETG id in catalog.

product_lines.notes: Glass-fiber composite with the base polymer unstated on the listing — likely PLA or PA, but no id can be assigned without confirming the matrix.

product_lines.notes: Referenced only in the site menu and not confirmed on a product page; if real they would be pla-gradient / pla-wood / cosmetic pla, but no id is asserted here.

additional_notes: Also sells SLA/LCD/DLP resins (Standard Plus, Water Washable, Eco Standard, engineering grades), LCD 3D printers, UV ink, curing boxes and filament dryers — the broadest non-filament hardware lineup in this cluster, suggesting a manufacturing group rather than a pure filament label. Target sectors: jewelry, dental, medical, aerospace, education. Products claim FDA, REACH, CE, RoHS and TSCA compliance. EU distributor pricing: filaments EUR 12.50-29.95, resins EUR 19.95-29.99. Further listings at https://filament2print.com/en/brand/112-jamg-he, https://3dpartnershop.com/brands/jamghe/ and https://protomont.com/brand/jamg-he/. Build plates not confirmed, so makes_plates is left unset. Manufacturing city was not established; China origin is inferred from company background.

provenance.conflicts: Ownership chain (brand owned by Yongchanghe, established 2001, itself a subsidiary of Meilianxing Technology Co., Ltd.) comes from a single AI-summarised fetch and needs corroboration. No HQ city or factory location was found. The owner-verified AceAddity relationship is not acknowledged by either company publicly.
